verdict: A real ROAS drop this week — purchases have stalled and we're on it.
narrative: This period delivered $5,311.58 in revenue on $1,501.13 in Meta spend, but the week-over-week picture is difficult: return on ad spend fell 81% to 3.54, and purchases dropped 62.5% compared to the prior week. The core issue is conversion stoppage — zero purchases have been recorded since August 15, even as site traffic is up 13.5% week-over-week, which points to a landing page or offer mismatch rather than an audience problem. The top campaign, the Muslim Subscription Box, absorbed 57% of total spend and showed lumpy conversion clusters with nothing sustaining; that budget allocation is being reviewed now. Ad creative is also being refreshed this week to address fatigue risk, and the funnel test and UTM tracking are on track to close by August 31.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend this period, down 81% from last week
spent on the top campaign this period — 57% of total ad budget — with purchases stalled since Aug 15
Google Business Profile actions this period (calls, directions, website clicks), though local engagement dropped sharply in the past few days

watch_item.issue: Zero purchases recorded since August 15 despite rising site traffic — spend is running but the offer or landing page is not converting.
watch_item.fix: Ad creative is being refreshed this week and the landing page offer alignment is under active review ahead of the August 31 funnel test close.
